Plan review

Want a person to check your plan?

A person checks your transcript against your DegreeSteps plan, tells you which of your courses your school is likely to accept, and drafts the questions to send the school.

What you get

  • A person compares your transcript with your DegreeSteps plan, course by course.
  • A short list of the courses your school is likely to accept, the ones that are uncertain, and the published school rule behind each.
  • The questions to send the school’s admissions or transfer-credit office, drafted for you to send in your own name.
  • Your review by email within 5 days of receiving your transcript.

$49 one time, USD

Your school makes the final decision about credit. A review helps you ask the right questions; it is not a promise that a course will count.
